summary: Google sign-in through Firebase, sessions that follow the ID token, and roles as server-set custom claims, with a dry-run-first tool to set them. Sign-in errors read as sentences; an unconfigured build says so.

packageName.label: Dart package name
packageName.help: Lower case with underscores, e.g. acme_crm. It is the app's import name and cannot contain spaces.

firebaseProjectId.label: Firebase project ID
firebaseProjectId.help: The Google Cloud / Firebase project this application uses, e.g. acme-crm-prod. It must already exist with Firebase enabled.

platforms.label: Platforms
platforms.help: web for a web-only dashboard, or web,ios,android to build the mobile apps too.

nextSteps: firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-local "flutter test test_emulator/auth"
In lib/src/configure.dart: import 'auth/auth_setup.dart'; and return <Override>[...await firebaseAuthOverrides()]
Firebase console > Authentication: enable Google, and add the app's web address under Authorised domains
